Boryung (a major South Korean pharmaceutical and healthcare company)
is actively expanding its digital healthcare portfolio, focusing on
remote patient monitoring (RPM), wearable ECG patches, and digital chronic disease management solutions
rather than manufacturing direct-to-consumer fitness smartwatches or standalone continuous glucose monitors (CGMs).
Boryung's Digital Healthcare & Wearables Focus
Remote Patient Monitoring (RPM):
Boryung invests in and partners with specialized digital health innovators to build platforms for managing chronic conditions like hypertension and cardiac irregularities outside clinical settings.
Wearable ECG Patches:
The company collaborates on clinical-grade, adhesive cardiac monitoring technologies designed to track heart rhythms and transmit data remotely to physicians.
Partnerships vs. Direct Devices:
Rather than selling retail smartwatches or sleep trackers, Boryung integrates medical-grade biosensors into broader hospital-to-home telehealth infrastructures.
